name: FUN_WF_RULES
description: This table contains approval rule metadata and assignment information.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Rule identifier and primary key.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to FUN_WF_PARTICIPANTS table.

columns.name: RULE_ALIAS
columns.description: Alias rule entered by a user from the BPM worklist application.

columns.name: RULE_NAME
columns.description: This is alias without spaces. This is only internal to BPM and not exposed to users on the UI.

columns.name: RULE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Approval rule description as entered by the user on UI / Spreadsheet.

columns.name: RULE_INDEX
columns.description: Serial number by which rules are displayed on the BPM worklist applcication.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Value to indicate whether rule is active or not.

columns.name: ADVANCE_MODE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether rule is in advance mode.

columns.name: TREE_MODE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether rule is in tree mode.

columns.name: RULE_PRIORITY_CODE
columns.description: Priority determines the order in which rules are evaluated in the ruleset.

columns.name: RULE_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective start date of the approval rule per the database time zone.

columns.name: RULE_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective end date of the approval rule per the database time zone.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of the business condition.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Used for mapping a rule to a Sensor ID / Dataset ID etc.

columns.name: IMPLICIT_FLAG
columns.description: Used to determine whether a rule is implicit or not

columns.name: SQL_FILTER
columns.description: SQL Payload corresponding to the business conditions

columns.name: BOSS_FILTER
columns.description: BOSS Extraction Payload corresponding to the business conditions

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
